# Locus

> Your coding agent can't act as the wrong account. AI-native identity plane for coding agents: pin a binding and every CLI command, MCP tool and agent session is sealed to that tenant until a human re-pins. Wrong account, impossible.

Identity is resolved at the gate, not in the prompt. Bindings hold principal, tenant, CredentialRefs and policy; sessions are HMAC-sealed to exactly one binding, and agents cannot pin. Sibling product: Phantom (phm.dev) keeps real secret values out of model context.

## Start

- [README](https://github.com/ashlrai/locus/blob/main/README.md): install options, 30-second start, MCP wiring
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/ashlrai/locus/blob/main/AGENTS.md): agent operating rules and invariants
- [capabilities.json](https://locus.dev/capabilities.json): machine-readable capabilities, install and commands
- [server.json](https://locus.dev/server.json): MCP registry manifest for io.github.ashlrai/locus-mcp
